event: ThunderTalk Gaming vs Team WE — Game 2
logicalSettlementImplication: At the same final kill margin, the earlier TT +5.5 and TT +7.5 lines would also lose. This is a mathematical implication, not a separately supplied result.

snapshots.state: TT led 2-0 kills and 13.3k-12.3k gold; TT first tower; WE first dragon
snapshots.reviewGrade: permissible same-line reassessment while state remained favorable

snapshots.failure: The handicap widened by two kills while TT's moneyline deteriorated sharply and no qualifying repair was established.

snapshots.state: WE led 7-6 kills and 23.9k-22.1k gold; TT had three Void Grubs; WE had first dragon
snapshots.failure: The model treated the wider cushion as protection despite worsening moneyline, gold position, and thesis quality.

rootCauses: Changed-line reassessment incorrectly reset thesis history.
Wider handicap size was treated as positive evidence.
The stress test modeled one fight rather than a fight-objective-follow-up cascade.
Equal or near-equal kills were treated as robust return-damage evidence even though kill production was concentrated in Xin Zhao and primary carry conversion remained unproven.

modelCorrection.warningTrigger: positive handicap widens by at least 2.0 kills
modelCorrection.hardVeto: warning plus at least two adverse repricing, state, structure, conversion, or fragile-kill-production signals
modelCorrection.revisionCap: one initial lean and at most one non-material reassessment before a full withdrawal-and-repair sequence
modelCorrection.stressTest: favorite fight plus immediate objective conversion plus next forced setup or base-defense sequence
modelCorrection.reentry: two new structured-fight conversions, stabilization, restored function, and explicit repair
